visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with short black hair and bold eyeliner, wearing a white off-the-shoulder blouse, speaks directly to the camera in a room. Behind her is a black metal shelving unit holding a geometric lamp and a small plant. (2) She holds up a white square box labeled 'soundcore Sleep A30' and presents its contents, which include multiple pairs of white silicone ear tips and wings neatly arranged in a tray. (3) The scene shifts to the woman lying in bed on a red pillow, eyes closed, with a small white earbud visible in her ear; the lighting is dim and warm. (4) A montage sequence shows a male figure tossing in bed, followed by a CGI animation of a white circular charging case emitting pulsating soundwave graphics. (5) A close-up of a smartphone screen shows a mobile application interface with various soundscape icons like rain, waves, and forests; a finger interacts with the touch interface. (6) The woman is seen sleeping on a green sofa, then suddenly wakes up with a startled expression, looking directly into the lens. (7) She is now outdoors in a park or street setting, wearing different white earbuds, speaking excitedly while gesturing with her hands towards her ears.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a high-pitched, energetic female voice speaking with a friendly, narrative tone. A bright, mid-tempo pop background track with a steady electronic beat supports the speech. (2) A sharp 'digital click' SFX occurs as the woman holds up the product box, followed by her continued enthusiastic narration. (3) The background music maintains its energy, while the vocal delivery becomes more descriptive about product features. (4) A short 'whoosh' or 'ding' sound effect coincides with the display of the soundscape app interface. (5) A sudden shift occurs as a male voice off-screen says 'Get up!' in a teasing tone, followed by the female making a brief, surprised exclamation. (6) The final phase features the woman speaking in an outdoor environment; the vocal pitch remains high and excited, while the background music swells slightly for the closing call to action.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Linear: Problem -> Solution -> Comparison -> Call to Action
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a promotional review for Soundcore headphones. It starts by identifying common sleep issues with traditional earphones, introduces the Soundcore Sleep A30 as a comfortable alternative for sleeping, and then pivots to the Liberty 5 for outdoor use, emphasizing value for money compared to competitors.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The creator actively displays the product packaging, demonstrates product features, includes brand-specific slogans, and provides a 'comment to win' giveaway call to action.
